import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    index = 1
    
    results = []
    
    for i in range(n):
        if index >= len(data):
            break
        
        raw_materials = int(data[index])
        labor = int(data[index + 1])
        overhead = int(data[index + 2])
        index += 3
        
        total_cost = raw_materials + labor + overhead
        gross_profit = total_cost * 0.20
        
        if gross_profit > 100000:
            tax_deduction = gross_profit * 0.15
        else:
            tax_deduction = gross_profit * 0.10
        
        net_profit = gross_profit - tax_deduction
        
        if net_profit >= 75000:
            status = "Highly Profitable"
        elif 50000 <= net_profit <= 74999:
            status = "Moderately Profitable"
        else:
            status = "Less Profitable"
        
        results.append(f"Product {i + 1}:")
        results.append(f"Total Production Cost: ₹{total_cost}")
        results.append(f"Gross Profit: ₹{gross_profit:.2f}")
        results.append(f"Tax Deduction: ₹{tax_deduction:.2f}")
        results.append(f"Net Profit: ₹{net_profit:.2f}")
        results.append(f"Product Status: {status}")
    
    print('\n'.join(results))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
